name: Shikyou
source:
One of the candidates for a regular room, even a good family ward.
His hobby is collecting antique jars.
Whenever he has a problem, he cries at the "old man" he always accompanies.

[From [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/shinooku/chara/shikyo.html]official website[/url]]
